_about: Power outage sources used for the 'Nearby outages' panel around the location you search for. type=arcgis: a utility's PUBLIC ArcGIS outage-points query URL (no key, no login). bbox = [west, south, east, north] the feed covers. type=link: no free machine feed, so the app only links to the utility's own outage map. Never add feeds that need a login, an API key copied from a web page, or a CAPTCHA. Restart after editing. See docs/DATA-SOURCES.md.

sources.name: Florida Power & Light (incl. former Gulf Power)
